title: Run your own cleaning business under a name people trust.
intro: JaniCrew franchisees own and operate their business independently. They adopt the JaniCrew name, serve their own community, and uphold the JaniCrew Standard. The rest is theirs.

teaser.title: Own a JaniCrew in your community
teaser.body: Independently owned, locally operated, backed by a name and a standard your customers can recognise. See what it takes to start a JaniCrew of your own.

model.title: You own it
model.body: A JaniCrew franchise is your business. You hire your crew, choose your accounts, and keep the relationships you build.

model.title: You carry the name
model.body: The JaniCrew diamond on your shirts and your truck tells customers what to expect before you say a word.

model.title: You uphold the Standard
model.body: Every JaniCrew commits to the same written standard: scoped work, insured crews, a local owner on the phone, and a free walkthrough for every prospect.

whoFor: People who already clean well and want their own name on the door.
Owner-operators who would rather be on site than behind a desk.
Anyone who takes pride in a building that looks right when the lights come on.

provides.title: The brand
provides.body: The JaniCrew name, logo, uniforms and vehicle graphics.

provides.title: The Standard
provides.body: The written scope templates, quote worksheet and checklists every JaniCrew uses.

provides.title: Training
provides.body: Initial training on the JaniCrew method and the quote process.

provides.title: Territory
provides.body: A defined local territory for your JaniCrew.

commit: Work to the written JaniCrew Standard on every account.
Carry insurance and bonding and hold the licences your area requires.
Wear the uniform and keep the diamond visible on your crew and vehicles.
Offer every prospect a free, no-obligation walkthrough and a written monthly estimate.

steps.title: Say hello
steps.body: Send the enquiry form below or call us. Tell us where you are and what you clean today.

steps.title: Talk it through
steps.body: A conversation about your market, your goals, and what a JaniCrew territory would look like.

steps.title: Review the details
steps.body: Terms, territory and training, in writing.

steps.title: Open your JaniCrew
steps.body: Uniforms on, truck lettered, first walkthrough booked.
